description: This line plot illustrates performance metrics across varying numbers of tokens for four different data categories. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with numeric tick markers regularly spaced at intervals of 200. The y-axis lacks a specific text label but employs a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with numeric tick marks set at intervals of 10. The "Tutorials" category is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at an initial value of approximately 23 at 200 tokens, steadily increases to a peak of roughly 29.5 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to finish at approximately 28.5 at 1000 tokens. The "Library Documentation" category is depicted by a solid red line with circular markers, starting at around 26 at 200 tokens, rising to a peak of approximately 32.5 at 800 tokens, before decreasing to roughly 27.5 at 1000 tokens. The "StackOverflow posts" category is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers, which starts at a high of approximately 33 at 200 tokens and exhibits a continuous downward trend, falling to about 30.5 at 500 tokens, dropping sharply to 19 at 800 tokens, and ending at its lowest point of approximately 11.5 at 1000 tokens. Finally, the "Github files" category is represented by a solid green line with circular markers, initiating at roughly 28 at 200 tokens, climbing to a peak of approximately 33 at 800 tokens, and subsequently declining to about 30 at the final x-axis value of 1000 tokens.
